module.name: prefer-nullish-coalescing
module.description: Fix nullish guard ternaries only when the repeated identifier resolves to a local binding.

scenarios.name: should allow direct nullish coalescing and unrelated ternaries
scenarios.given: value ?? fallback or a ternary with an unrelated guard

scenarios.name: should fix a repeated identifier nullish guard
scenarios.given: const value = read(); value != null ? value : fallback
scenarios.then: a preferNullish violation is reported with an autofix that parenthesizes the fallback

scenarios.name: should preserve getter evaluation count
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced for repeated member access

scenarios.name: should preserve function call side effects
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced for repeated calls

scenarios.name: should preserve unbound identifiers that may be global accessors
scenarios.given: globalValue != null ? globalValue : fallback with no local binding
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced because repeated reads may invoke a global getter

scenarios.name: should preserve a guarded identifier when the result branch differs
scenarios.given: const user = read(); user != null ? account : fallback
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix is produced because the selected branch is not the guarded value

scenarios.name: should preserve logical fallback grouping
scenarios.when: the rule fixes a locally bound value
scenarios.then: the fallback is parenthesized after ?? so the result parses and retains its grouping

scenarios.name: should preserve conditional fallback grouping
scenarios.given: value != null ? value : ready ? left : right
scenarios.when: the rule fixes a locally bound value
scenarios.then: the conditional fallback remains one parenthesized ?? operand

scenarios.name: should preserve comments between nullish branches
scenarios.then: no violation or autofix removes the comment

scenarios.name: should preserve operand and enclosing expression precedence
scenarios.given: a nullish ternary with logical, conditional, or assignment fallback
scenarios.then: both operands and the full expression retain their grouping

scenarios.name: should preserve fallback side effects across parameter boundaries
scenarios.given: a locally bound parameter may be nullish or any falsy or truthy non-nullish value and fallback increments a counter
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the fixed expression returns the same value and invokes fallback exactly as many times as the original

scenarios.name: should preserve repeated getter state changes
scenarios.given: a property getter increments a counter each time the guarded expression is read
scenarios.when: ESLint evaluates the rule or applies its offered fix
scenarios.then: the source is unchanged and both original getter reads still occur
